model: WARtool/PaxDex shared context-aware shiny safety rules
levelActiveCondition: Move rules apply only when the move is in the wild Pokémon's reconstructed last four level-up moves at an encounter level.

Selfdestruct.preparation: Use Damp or Imprison. For Koffing/Weezing, current Reactive Gas + Damp behavior needs verification; Imprison is the conservative option.

Explosion.preparation: Use Damp or Imprison. For Koffing/Weezing, current Reactive Gas + Damp behavior needs verification; Imprison is the conservative option.

Memento.preparation: Use Taunt, Imprison, Encore into a harmless move, or another move-denial method. Trapping alone does not prevent Memento.

Final Gambit.preparation: Use a Ghost-type, Taunt or Imprison.

Healing Wish.effect: The move may cause the user to faint, but its behavior in a lone wild encounter still needs in-game verification.
Healing Wish.preparation: Treat this as an unverified setup risk; Taunt or Imprison is the conservative preparation.

Perish Song.effect: In a true single encounter, the user can faint when the perish count reaches zero. Horde members are intentionally excluded.
Perish Song.preparation: Catch or reset the battle before the count expires.

Teleport.effect: The wild Pokémon can end the battle before it is caught.
Teleport.preparation: Use Arena Trap, Imprison + Teleport, or a trapping move immediately.

Take Down.preparation: Use a Ghost-type or reduce turns spent battling.

Double-Edge.preparation: Use a Ghost-type or reduce turns spent battling.

Submission.preparation: Use a Ghost-type or reduce turns spent battling.

Brave Bird.preparation: Use a resistant, high-Defense target and avoid extended battles.

Flare Blitz.preparation: Use a resistant, high-Defense target and avoid extended battles.

Head Smash.effect: The user takes heavy recoil damage.
Head Smash.preparation: Use a Rock-resistant, high-Defense target and capture or control it quickly. Ghost typing does not block this Rock-type move.

Wood Hammer.preparation: Use a resistant, high-Defense target and avoid extended battles.

Jump Kick.effect: The user takes crash damage if the move misses or fails.
Jump Kick.preparation: Avoid Ghost-types and Protect-like failure conditions.

Hi Jump Kick.effect: The user takes crash damage if the move misses or fails.
Hi Jump Kick.preparation: Avoid Ghost-types and Protect-like failure conditions.

Curse.effect: Ghost-type users sacrifice half of their maximum HP.

Thrash.effect: The user becomes confused after the locked attack ends.
Thrash.preparation: Catch quickly or use Own Tempo support.

Outrage.effect: The user becomes confused after the locked attack ends.
Outrage.preparation: Catch quickly or use Own Tempo support.

Petal Dance.effect: The user becomes confused after the locked attack ends.
Petal Dance.preparation: Catch quickly or use Own Tempo support.

Belly Drum.effect: The user loses half of its maximum HP when the move succeeds.

Sketch.effect: If Sketch fails, wild Smeargle can reach Struggle very quickly.
Sketch.preparation: Bring a predictable move for Sketch or deny it immediately; avoid long setup sequences.

Transform.effect: Transform copies a moveset with limited PP and can create a dangerous or slow capture state.
Transform.preparation: Lead with a controlled low-risk moveset or prevent Transform before beginning a long capture setup.

Trick.effect: The wild Pokémon can exchange held items with your catcher; a Toxic Orb or other damaging item can become dangerous.
Trick.preparation: Use an itemless or safe-item catcher, or deny the move with Taunt/Imprison.

Switcheroo.effect: The wild Pokémon can exchange held items with your catcher; a Toxic Orb or other damaging item can become dangerous.
Switcheroo.preparation: Use an itemless or safe-item catcher, or deny the move with Taunt/Imprison.

Rage Powder.effect: Can redirect a targeted cleanup move in a multi-opponent encounter.
Rage Powder.preparation: Move-specific preparation is generated from encounter context.

Follow Me.effect: Can redirect a targeted cleanup move in a multi-opponent encounter.
Follow Me.preparation: Move-specific preparation is generated from encounter context.

Dry Skin.effect: The Pokémon loses HP each turn in harsh sunlight, but the encounter dump does not expose active battle weather.
Dry Skin.preparation: Avoid harsh sunlight and verify the location's current battle weather.

Solar Power.effect: The Pokémon loses HP each turn in harsh sunlight, but the encounter dump does not expose active battle weather.
Solar Power.preparation: Avoid harsh sunlight and verify the location's current battle weather.

Sticky Barb.effect: This species can hold Sticky Barb and lose HP each turn while holding it.
Sticky Barb.preparation: Do not rely on False Swipe alone; bring Heal Pulse or a safe way to remove or replace the item.

132.name: Transform / Imposter preparation
132.effect: Ditto's Transform or possible Imposter activation can copy limited-PP moves and create a dangerous or slow capture state.
132.preparation: Use a controlled lead with a safe moveset and plan the capture before Ditto copies it.

compoundRules.name: Hoppip / Skiploom compound setup
compoundRules.effect: Multiple capture hazards can overlap: redirection, Memento, Bounce and Worry Seed may require one combined plan.
compoundRules.preparation: Use Taunt or Imprison to cover Memento and redirection together. A faster Extreme Speed or Feint can beat +2 redirection; do not rely only on Overcoat when Worry Seed is active.
